messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the all-hands incident segment — sharing the RCA link and a concise owner checklist. Please ack and drop ETAs if you own an action. RCA: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-27 :link: 
Ethan: Got it, thanks. I'm owner for the query-plan fallback item. Will sketch a rollout plan by EOD.
Priya: Thanks Maya. I own the dashboard alerts tuning and runbook clarifications. Need help confirming the alert thresholds with SRE. @Ava can you spare 30m tomorrow? :calendar:
Ava: Yup, I can do 09:30 PST. Priya — bring the current alert noise numbers.
Noah: Will take the canary routing fallback implementation (Dedicated -> Hosted fallback). Quick Q — do we prefer a hard cap or probabilistic fallback?
Maya: Prefer probabilistic for 2 weeks then hard cap if cost spikes. Documented in the RCA notes under 'fallback policy'.
Ethan: FYI, initial perf regression repro steps (from postmortem):
```
# repro snippet
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-14b-quant","prompt":"X"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# watch for queue-length > 150
```
Noah: Thanks — will use that in integration tests.
Priya: IncidentBot — can you post the list of tracked action items and assignees into the ops tracker?
IncidentBot: Action items created: INC-2026-27-A1 (Ethan) query-plan fallback design, INC-2026-27-A2 (Priya) alert tuning & runbook, INC-2026-27-A3 (Noah) canary routing fallback, INC-2026-27-A4 (Ava) dashboard gaps & profiling. All assigned with 2-week SLAs. Links: https://redwood.internal/ops/INC-2026-27/actions
Ava: Quick note — profiling shows memory spikes come from KV cache eviction path. I think a conservative LRU tweak reduces p99 memory by ~12%. Putting the experiment in my calendar for tomorrow.
Maya: Great. One ask from leadership — capture expected customer impact (if any) for each action item in the ops tracker. Helps with prioritization.
Ethan: Will add estimated customer impact fields today.
Priya: Will sync with SRE after the 09:30 call and update runbook PR.
Noah: I'll prepare the canary config and add rollback steps to the PR. ETA Wed EOD.
Maya: Thanks all. Can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when you've added ETA + customer impact in the tracker? Planning a quick 15m sync Friday to close dependencies.
Ava: ✅ added.
Ethan: ✅ added.
Priya: ✅ will add after call.
Noah: ✅ added.
Maya: Closing thread — if anything blocks, DM me or drop in #eng-oncall.
